usedFor: Basecamp holds the projects and to-dos, HubSpot holds the deals, and “New Project” can start a “Create Deal”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Project” in Basecamp, then “Create Deal” in HubSpot
bestTemplate.why: A new Basecamp project opens a HubSpot deal, so the work has a sales record from day one.

watchOut: “Update Deal” needs a deal ID, so match the Basecamp event to an existing deal first.
